sources.description: One prospect who may interest the Denver Broncos on Day 3 of the 2026 NFL Draft is Navy running back/wide receiver Eli Heidenreich. He is a 6-0, 198-pound playmaker who profiles as an intriguing pass-catching do-it-all running back in the NFL. The Athletic’s Dane Brugler has Heidenreich ranked as his RB9 and projects him to […]
